name: Puffling · Gremlet #13
description:
A puffin chick with a beak too big for its face and a lot of confidence.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Puffling in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
